line: The job ended without incident, and the fee reflects that — I prefer the incident, Shiny, but I’ll take the pay.
Smooth sailing and a flat fee — I don’t mind the first, but the second leaves me cold. Let’s aim for better, Shiny.
The job closed without incident, and the fee is at the low end. I will note that in the ledger, and consider if this kind of work is worth the margin.
The job went smoothly, but the rate was light. I’ll note that in the ledger and think twice before chasing this kind of work again.
The job closed cleanly. The payout is clean, but it’s not enough to make me want to repeat it.
Safe, and the payout is enough to keep the lights on. I don’t mind the lights staying on, as long as they’re not flickering.
Safe, and the pay was plain. I prefer the pay to be better, but I will take plain if it's all we've got, Shiny.
The job is closed, no one got hurt — but the take is small, and I'm not happy about that.
Low risk, small pay — I don’t mind the risk, Shiny, but I do mind the math.
Shiny. The pay was thin, but the job didn’t bleed us. I’ll take that over most things — just not over much.
